meta.name: taobao-shop-catalog
meta.description: Browse a Taobao or Tmall shop's product catalog by shopId, returning paginated product listings with itemId and title. Use when user asks to scrape a Taobao shop, get all products from a store, list items in a Taobao/Tmall shop, fetch shop catalog by userId or shopId, 采集淘宝店铺商品, 抓取淘宝店铺所有商品, 获取天猫店铺商品列表, 淘宝店铺目录, 按店铺ID采集商品. Also applies to shop inventory monitoring, competitor store analysis, and bulk itemId collection from a specific seller.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浏览淘宝或天猫店铺的商品目录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取淘宝或天猫店铺的商品列表
copy.tagline_en: Browse product catalog of Taobao or Tmall shops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fetch product listings from Taobao or Tmall stores in bulk

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据店铺 ID 浏览淘宝或天猫店铺的商品目录，返回分页的商品列表（含商品 ID 和标题）。
howto.when: 当用户要求抓取淘宝店铺商品、获取店铺所有商品、列出店铺商品列表，或提到店铺 ID 时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看店铺 67095450 有哪些商品。
say.note: Claude 会打开该店铺目录页并提取商品列表。

say.text: 列出这个天猫店铺的所有商品。
say.note: Claude 会识别店铺 ID 并分页获取商品。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can browse a Taobao or Tmall shop's product catalog by shop ID, returning paginated product listings with item ID and title.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to scrape a Taobao shop, get all products from a store, list items in a Taobao/Tmall shop, or mentions a shop ID.

say_en.text: Show me the products of shop 67095450.
say_en.note: Claude will open the shop catalog page and extract product listings.

say_en.text: List all items from this Tmall store.
say_en.note: Claude will identify the shop ID and paginate through products.
